alt: 【2001년 · 서울】 임진왜란 때 사라진 후궁 묘표, 400여 년 만에 고국으로 — 기사 장면을 사진풍으로 재구성한 AI 이미지.
visualStyle: Contemporary documentary photographic realism, natural gently desaturated color, restrained fine sensor noise, clear materials, no fake aged scratches. No invented devices or objects beyond the article setting.
sceneBrief: 2001 return of a Joseon royal consort stone grave marker: conservators in ordinary early-2000s clothing with white cotton gloves carefully unpacking a weathered small upright stone marker from a protective crate in a conservation room. Oblique inscription not legible. Not an ancient scene.
